title: Art. 9.18 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 9 - Passenger Data Exchange Systems, B. Advance Passenger Information (API), 9.18
content: Recommended Practice. Contracting States' and aircraft operators' API systems, including iAPI, should be capable of 24/7 operation, with procedures in place to minimize disruption in the event of a system outage or failure.
